title: Hollerhorn Spirit Society Rye Whiskey
about: Hollerhorn Distilling sits on a hillside outside Naples, the old grape village at the south end of Canandaigua Lake. Karl Neubauer, a Naples native and longtime custom home builder, studied distilling for some fifteen years before he and his wife Melissa opened in 2018, in a building Karl framed from timber salvaged out of collapsing barns. A fire in May 2022 destroyed the tasting room, but the stills and barrels survived, and the couple rebuilt with help from the whole valley. Karl works almost entirely with fruit and grain grown within a short drive of the distillery.

The Hollerhorn Spirit Society is Karl’s way of gathering what he calls “spirit nerds” to taste, share notes and blend together. Its first release, in April 2024, was this rye: two barrels of Hollerhorn’s own Empire Rye, distilled in Naples from New York-grown grain, married with one barrel of rye whiskey from Wilderness Trail Distillery in Danville, Kentucky. Wilderness Trail’s co-founder, Dr. Pat Heist, is one of Karl’s distilling teachers and helped bring the Kentucky barrel north.

The blend was chosen at the distillery by a group of friends: Rochester’s whiskey enthusiast and barrel-pick clubs and Nick Laplant of the Syracuse Spirit Society. Each Spirit Society bottle also honors an artist; this label carries the work of Phoebe Quinn (@peoplefears). Hollerhorn describes caramel, maple, vanilla and brown sugar, with light char, a wisp of smoke and wood spice. It is bottled at 102.5 proof.
facts: Two Hollerhorn NYS Empire Rye + one Wilderness Trail rye (Kentucky)
